fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (AVGO) has declined 38% from all-time highs but shows recovery prospects in November driven by Anthropic IPO and increased orders.
fields.summary_ko.1: The company is overcoming GPU flexibility limitations through custom-designed AI chips and is expected to achieve annual AI semiconductor revenue growth of 2x annually in 2026–2028 by securing major customers including Meta and OpenAI.
